preconditions.description: The length of word s is between 1 and 100 characters.
The length of word t is between 1 and 100 characters.
All characters in word s are lowercase Latin letters.
All characters in word t are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if s == t[::-1] else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if word t is the reverse of word s, otherwise 'NO'.
